in_english.name: Lajlah
in_english.meaning: Lajlah means night or intense darkness
in_english.long_meaning: Lajlah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'ل ج ل' (l-j-l), meaning night or intense darkness. In Islamic tradition, the name may symbolize tranquility and peace associated with the night. It is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the universal significance of night in spiritual and cultural contexts.
